title: Bump agnix lint engine to 0.56.1
summary: A dependency bump: the `osf` crate moves its pinned `agnix-core` lint engine from 0.54.0 to 0.56.1 (which pulls `agnix-rules` 0.56.5), and the compiled-in `AGNIX_VERSION` constant is updated to match so the version guard keeps passing. No lint logic, wiring or call sites change — only the engine version the linter adapter reports and links against.
